# ”800 procent är inte tillräckligt”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-08  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts cover a weak Stockholm session (-1.6%) and a slightly lower Wall Street close. The fall was cushioned by strong US Treasury auctions, while the US 10-year yield sits at 5.3%, oil is rising on Hormuz/Iran escalation, and they flag the risk that leveraged bond holders get caught by the fast rate moves. Company talk centres on Samsung falling despite an ~800% profit jump because it missed estimates, Fast Retailing outperforming H&M, upcoming lockup expiries (especially Silex on 3 November) and broker recommendation changes ahead of the reporting season.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 ATT — Attendo | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

SEB (cited analyst) downgrades Attendo from buy to hold.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view, not the hosts' own. SEB cut its recommendation to hold during the pre-report update round, which suggests limited upside before the Q3 reporting season.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further broker downgrades follow
- if Q3 report disappoints

> *"Attendo sänks till behåll från tidigare köp till SCB som gör det."*

---

### 🟠 AMBEA — Ambea | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

SEB raises its Ambea target price ~15% as the Humana acquisition closes.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view. The target raise mostly reflects recalculation after the Humana deal; the hosts call it a re-modelling rather than a change in thesis. Mildly positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Humana integration disappoints
- if synergies fail to materialise

> *"samma SCB skruvar upp riktkursen för Ambea ganska så mycket, 15 procent, ungefär. Ambea har ju köpt Humana"*

---

### 🟢 MU — Micron | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

D.A. Davidson (cited analyst) says Micron could triple; stock rose 4%.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view with no host endorsement. The strong memory cycle supports it, but the hosts note the stock has already run hard this year, and Samsung's miss shows expectations are very high.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory pricing turns
- if peers like Samsung keep missing elevated estimates

> *"Micron lyfte igår, minnestillverkaren, 4 % efter att D.A. Davidson uppgett att den här aktien kan tredubblas."*
